name: skillboard
description: Portable agent setup: continuity (handoff + persisting-plans), memory index + recall, self-learning skill factory, dev docs, lazy-code discipline, and the Skillboard dashboard. On Codex it ships skills + AGENTS.md instructions and runs the sync lifecycle hooks from hooks/hooks.json; the async memory-index/dashboard refresh is skipped on Codex (run `skillboard` manually).

interface.shortDescription: Portable agent setup: continuity, memory, and discipline skills.
interface.longDescription: Portable agent setup as a Codex plugin: continuity skills (handoff, persisting-plans), memory recall, a self-learning skill factory, dev-docs, and the lazy-code ladder. Instructions load from AGENTS.md; skills route manually via the AGENTS.md index. Codex runs the sync SessionStart/tool hooks from hooks/hooks.json; the async memory-index + dashboard refresh is not yet supported on Codex, so run the `skillboard` command manually to refresh it.
